outlook.statement: Management has deployed rigorous cost-optimization frameworks, established stricter inventory control mechanisms, and shifted product parameters toward high-margin domestic furnishing fabrics and garments to expand structural top-line velocity.

The board of directors of the company feels that textile sector is fast growing in India, hence due to increasing scope and demand for exports in India, the company at the same parallel will put all the efforts to improve the quality and productive to get more order at competitive rates and try to maintain high quality and productivity in the manufactured goods. Barring unforeseen circumstances, the company is confident of achieving better results in the current year.

risks: fluctuating raw textile material input costs
intense competition within the domestic fabric supply network
Upcoming Western regulations like the European Union's Digital Product Passport demand strict supply chain traceability, creating a legal hurdle for unaligned exporters.
International retail chains are heavily slashing their purchase order volumes to aggressively clear out excess residual warehouse inventory, suppressing near-term growth.
Ongoing maritime logistical friction and volatile container freight costs in West Asia continue to compress corporate export margins and delay shipping timelines.
A domestic drop in raw cotton production to 290.91 lakh bales causes sudden internal yarn price hikes and localized input raw material shortages.
